reason: Sent the browser-task prompt to agent QA-20261120-215501-24yz and confirmed the reply reports the page title "Example Domain".
steps: Navigated to http://localhost:47891 — Gamut home loaded with the "QA-20261120-215501-24yz" agent listed in the sidebar (screenshot step1-home.png).
Clicked the QA-20261120-215501-24yz agent in the sidebar — agent page opened with an empty message input and status "idle".

Typed "Open a browser and go to https://example.com. Tell me the page title." and pressed Enter — text stayed in the input and was not sent. The placeholder reads "Press cmd+enter to send", so this may be by design rather than a bug. I then clicked the Send button, and the session "Browser Page Title Check" started with status "working" and a ToolSearch / Open Browser tool card (screenshots step3-message-typed.png, step3-message-sent.png).
Waited up to 3 minutes for "Example Domain" — the wait returned after the agent finished in about 4 seconds ("Worked for 4s · 3 tool calls").

Verified the response and took a screenshot — the agent replied: "The page title at https://example.com is "Example Domain". I've closed the browser." The status returned to "idle" (screenshot step5-response.png).
